# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Namespace
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: n8n
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Secrets
# Note: In production, use a secrets manager (Vault, SOPS, External Secrets, etc.)
# and do NOT commit real credentials. These are placeholders matching the .env.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: postgres-secret
  namespace: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: "changeUser"
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "changePassword"
  POSTGRES_DB: "n8n"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER: "changeUser"
  POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD: "changePassword"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: n8n-secret
  namespace: n8n
type: Opaque
stringData:
  RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN: "changeRunnerAuthToken"
  DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD: "changePassword"
  N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: "changeEncryptionKey-REPLACE-WITH-32CHAR-RANDOM"
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Init script ConfigMap (mirrors init-data.sh)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: postgres-init
  namespace: n8n
data:
  init-data.sh: |
    #!/bin/bash
    set -e;

    if [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER:-}" ] && [ -n "${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
        psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" <<-EOSQL
            CREATE USER ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER} WITH PASSWORD '${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD}';
            GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE ${POSTGRES_DB} TO ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER};
            GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO ${POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER};
    EOSQL
    else
        echo "SETUP INFO: No Environment variables given!"
    fi
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PostgreSQL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: 5432
      targetPort: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  serviceName: postgres
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: postgres
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          volumeMounts:
            - name: db-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: init-scripts
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - 'pg_isready -h localhost -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 10
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - sh
                - -c
                - 'pg_isready -h localhost -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
      volumes:
        - name: init-scripts
          configMap:
            name: postgres-init
            defaultMode: 0755
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: db-storage
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# n8n
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 5678
      targetPort: http
    - name: broker
      port: 5679
      targetPort: broker
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  serviceName: n8n
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      initContainers:
        - name: wait-for-postgres
          image: postgres:18
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - sh
            - -c
            - 'until pg_isready -h postgres -p 5432 -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"; do echo "waiting for postgres..."; sleep 2; done'
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
      containers:
        - name: n8n
          image: docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 5678
            - name: broker
              containerPort: 5679
          env:
            - name: DB_TYPE
              value: postgresdb
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST
              value: postgres
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT
              value: "5432"
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: postgres-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_NON_ROOT_USER
            - name: DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD
            - name: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_MODE
              value: external
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_LISTEN_ADDRESS
              value: 0.0.0.0
            - name: N8N_HOST
              value: n8n.example.com
            - name: N8N_PORT
              value: "5678"
            - name: N8N_PROTOCOL
              value: https
            - name: WEBHOOK_URL
              value: https://n8n.example.com/
            - name: GENERIC_TIMEZONE
              value: UTC
            - name: N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED
              value: "false"
          volumeMounts:
            - name: n8n-storage
              mountPath: /home/node/.n8n
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 60
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 6
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 2Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: n8n-storage
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 5Gi
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# n8n-runner
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: n8n-runner
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n-runner
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n-runner
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n-runner
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: n8n-runner
          image: n8nio/runners:2.43.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: n8n-secret
                  key: RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN
            - name: N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI
              value: http://n8n:5679
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ingress (TLS via cert-manager annotation — adjust to your cluster)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "16m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "3600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "3600"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - n8n.example.com
      secretName: n8n-tls
  rules:
    - host: n8n.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: n8n
                port:
                  number: 5678
---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PodDisruptionBudget for n8n (single-replica: ensure voluntary disruptions
# are blocked so upgrades don't take n8n offline unexpectedly).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: n8n
  namespace: n8n
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: n8n
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: n8n
